mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has recovered sharply from -43.1% (t-1w) to -22.3% (t-0w), a 20.8-point weekly gain. This sustained workplace return signals resumption of commuting routines and weekday retail activity, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 20.8 points week-on-week at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean over the last 28 days, or WORKPLACES declines below -30% in any of the next two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has stabilized at -26.1% (t-0w) after declining to -35.6% (t-2w), indicating public transport confidence is recovering. Restored transit use enables discretionary retail visits, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves more than 5 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 9.6 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls below -30% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility remains suppressed (-11.7% at t-0w) while RETAIL_REC is deeply negative (-24.4%). When outdoor recreation demand is constrained, consumers substitute toward indoor retail venues. As PARKS recovers, this substitution reverses, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises above -5% in any week
failure_condition: PARKS remains below -10% for all four weeks ahead, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has stabilized at +8.6% (t-0w), indicating essential-goods demand is steady and elevated. When essential mobility is high and stable, discretionary retail (RETAIL_REC) remains suppressed as consumers prioritize necessity over recreation. RETAIL_REC will remain negative over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM remains above +5% for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stable at +6.6% to +8.6% over t-2w to t-0w
regime_hint: steady state with elevated essential mobility
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +3% in any of the next two weeks, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean by more than 5 percentage points.

failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above +12% in any of the next two weeks, or WORKPLACES falls below -35% in any week, or RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days does not exceed the last 28-day mean.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -10% in any of the next two weeks, or the mean over the next 28 days exceeds the last 28-day mean.
